title.en: Chapter 15 — Tom Goes Home in the Dark

sentences.en: At night, Tom crossed the river alone.
He walked to the town, wet and silent.

sentences.ar: فات البيت من الشباك وخبى حاله.
sentences.en: He entered the house by the window and hid himself.

sentences.ar: خالته كانت قاعدة مع أم هاربر.
sentences.en: His aunt was sitting with Harper’s mother.
They were weeping and talking about the boys.

sentences.ar: قالت خالته: كان شقي، بس ما كان ابن حرام.
sentences.en: His aunt said: he was a rascal, but he was not a bad boy.

sentences.ar: توم كاد يطلع، بس ضل ساكت.
sentences.en: Tom almost came out, but he stayed silent.
